title: Down the Burrow
blurb: Zeb loves rabbits. With Finn's Shrink Torch, he goes down into a real rabbit burrow!
cover_prompt: Finn and Zeb kneel on a sunny grassy hill full of rabbit holes, with several fluffy wild brown rabbits around them; Zeb is beaming and holding out his hands towards a rabbit that hops up to him, Finn holds a glowing torch-shaped gadget with a swirl on it.
outfits: , wearing a khaki explorer shirt and shorts and a green safari hat, with binoculars round his neck
, wearing the same khaki explorer outfit and green safari hat, with a camera on a strap round his neck

sound.label: /air/
sound.intro: Listen for the /air/ sound, as in hair. In this story it is spelt three ways. Tap a word to hear it.

cracked: Rabbits live in burrows under the ground, and Zeb went down one! Finn and Zeb cracked the case!

text: Finn and Zeb are in the Den. Ping!
Zeb's best case yet: a pair of rabbits!
p1.prompt: Inside the cosy explorer den full of maps and fossils, a big wall screen shows two fluffy wild brown rabbits on a grassy hill; Zeb jumps up and down with joy, hugging a toy rabbit, while Finn grins and grabs his binoculars.

text: They go to a farm. The air is fresh.
A grassy hill is full of holes.
p2.prompt: A sunny green farm with a red barn and fields; Finn and Zeb walk up a grassy hill dotted with many round rabbit holes, breathing in the fresh air, a friendly farmer walking beside them.

text: The farmer points. Rabbits live there,
in tunnels under the hill. Take care!
p3.prompt: A friendly woman farmer with curly grey hair, a red checked shirt and green wellies points at the rabbit holes on the grassy hill; a cutaway shows a few tunnels running under the hill; Finn and Zeb look and listen.

text: Then a rabbit pops up! Zeb stares.
It sniffs the air. Its ears twitch.
p4.prompt: A fluffy wild brown rabbit pops its head out of a hole on the grassy hill, sniffing the air with its long ears up; Zeb kneels close by, staring at it with huge delighted eyes, Finn behind him smiling.

text: Where should they sit and watch?
On the hill, or by the hedge?
c1.prompt: Finn and Zeb stand at the edge of the grassy rabbit hill: on one side the open hilltop with rabbit holes, on the other a thick green hedge with wild flowers; Finn points at the hill, Zeb points at the hedge.

text: On the hill they keep still and stare.
A rabbit hops right past Zeb's feet!
b1a.prompt: Finn and Zeb sit very still on the grassy hill as a fluffy brown rabbit hops right past Zeb's feet; Zeb holds his breath with a delighted face, Finn watches.

text: By the hedge they spot a hare! It is
bigger, with long legs. Off it dashes!
b1b.prompt: Finn and Zeb crouch by a green hedge and see a brown hare with very long ears and long legs dashing off across the field; Finn points, Zeb gasps.

text: Zeb wants to see down there. Finn has a
gadget to spare: the Shrink Torch!
p5.prompt: Zeb peers longingly into a rabbit hole on the grassy hill while Finn holds up a shiny silver gadget shaped like a torch with a glowing swirl on its front, the Shrink Torch, grinning.

text: Zap! Zeb shrinks to rabbit size. Finn
holds a string. Take care, Zeb!
p6.prompt: A sparkly beam from Finn's Shrink Torch has shrunk Zeb to the size of a rabbit; tiny Zeb stands beside a rabbit hole wearing a little helmet with a head torch, a thin string tied round his waist; giant Finn kneels and holds the other end of the string, smiling.

text: Down Zeb goes. The tunnel slopes like
stairs. It is dark, but he is not scared!
p7.prompt: Inside a cosy earthy rabbit tunnel lit by tiny Zeb's head torch, the tunnel slopes down like stairs with roots hanging from the roof; tiny Zeb walks down bravely and happily, the thin string trailing behind him back up to the light.

text: A rabbit sniffs his hair. It is kind!
It hops off, and Zeb follows it.
p8.prompt: In the underground tunnel, a friendly rabbit, now as big as tiny Zeb, gently sniffs his hair with its twitchy nose; Zeb giggles, then follows the rabbit deeper along the tunnel, his head torch glowing.

text: In a snug nest of grass and fur, baby
rabbits sleep. Zeb stares. Kits!
p9.prompt: In a snug round underground room lined with soft grass and fluffy fur, five tiny sleeping baby rabbits curl up together; tiny Zeb kneels beside them with his hands over his mouth, overjoyed, his head torch glowing softly.

text: Up the stairs of earth Zeb climbs, into
the fresh air. Zap! He is big again.
p10.prompt: On the sunny grassy hill, Zeb is back to his normal size after a sparkly zap from the Shrink Torch, standing beside the rabbit hole and stretching his arms, while Finn coils up the string, both laughing.

text: The rabbits nibble the farm crops.
It is not fair! What should they do?

reveal.text: Farmers and rabbit fans do not always agree. Some farmers put up rabbit-proof fences to keep their crops safe. Some farms leave wild strips at the edges of fields for animals. People still talk about the best way. What would you do?

c2.prompt: At the edge of a field of young green crops, a few rabbits nibble the leafy plants; the friendly woman farmer with curly grey hair and green wellies stands with her hands on her hips looking puzzled; Finn and Zeb look from the rabbits to the farmer, thinking.

text: A fence goes up. The crops are safe.
The rabbits stare, then hop to the hill.
b2a.prompt: Finn, Zeb and the farmer finish putting up a wire mesh fence round the field of crops; on the other side the rabbits stare at it, then hop away towards their grassy hill.

text: They let the rabbits share the field.
The farmer grins. There is lots to share!
b2b.prompt: Rabbits nibble happily at one corner of the big crop field while the friendly farmer grins and shrugs; Finn and Zeb sit on the gate watching, smiling.

text: They plant a patch of clover just for
the rabbits. The crops are spared!
b2c.prompt: Finn and Zeb plant a little patch of clover with pink flowers beside the rabbit hill, and the rabbits come to munch it, leaving the farm crops alone; the farmer gives a thumbs up.

text: The sun sets. Go home now, or wait for
the rabbits to come out and play?
c3.prompt: Golden sunset over the farm and the grassy rabbit hill; the farmhouse lights glow on one side, and a few rabbit ears poke up from holes on the other; Finn looks towards home, Zeb tugs his sleeve towards the rabbits.

text: They wave to the farmer and head home
in the fresh air. What a fair day!
b3a.prompt: Finn and Zeb wave goodbye to the friendly farmer at the farm gate and walk home down a country lane at sunset, happy and tired.

text: At dusk, lots of rabbits pop up!
They hop and play. Zeb stares and grins.
b3b.prompt: At dusk, lots of rabbits pop up out of their holes on the grassy hill and hop and play together in the soft evening light; Zeb lies on his tummy staring and grinning, Finn beside him.

text: Back in the Den, Zeb draws a pair of
rabbits. His best case! Case cracked!
p11.prompt: Back in the cosy explorer den, Zeb proudly holds up his crayon drawing of two rabbits, and Finn pins it onto the corkboard of case notes; the wall screen shows a rabbit with a big green tick.

casefile.title: Rabbit
casefile.subtitle: Lives in a warren of tunnels.

facts.text: Up to 30 rabbits can share one warren, a home of tunnels and rooms under the ground.
Baby rabbits are called kits. They are born blind, and their eyes open when they are about 10 days old.
A rabbit's teeth never stop growing, so it chews and chews to keep them short.

casefile.prompt: A Creature Cases style fact file portrait of a wild European rabbit sitting up on a grassy bank beside a burrow entrance, soft brown fur, long ears up, big dark eye, white fluffy tail showing; a cutaway shows the tunnels of the warren underground; clean, bright, centred, like a collector card illustration, no people.

quiz.q: Which picture shows Zeb in the burrow?
quiz.why: Down the tunnel, with his head torch on.

quiz.q: Why did Finn hold a string?

options.text: So Zeb could find his way back up

quiz.why: The string led Zeb back up the tunnel.

quiz.q: Why was the farmer cross with the rabbits?
quiz.why: Rabbits eat the plants the farmer grows.

debrief.question: If you could shrink like Zeb, which animal's home would you go into?
